brief.product: Private, single-user, Android-first, online-only email PWA
nonNegotiables: Mobile tabs: Inbox, Activity, Drafts, More; Compose FAB
Activity filters: New, Questions, Failed, History
Inline agent action cards and bottom-sheet detail
Light-only calm white/gray UI with fine borders, minimal shadow, moderate radii
Semantic amber, green, red, and blue
Reduced motion support, WCAG AA, no 360px overflow

evidence.pattern: scan-first sender/subject/snippet rows, with compact but readable hierarchy
swipe triage complements rather than replaces visible controls
clear saved/filterable activity states support high-volume review
grouped event feed makes changes and follow-up states legible
three-pane layout preserves list context while reading and acting

bets.name: Inbox-led calm utility
bets.structure: Inbox is the default home. Activity is a separate bottom-tab work queue. Agent cards appear only where the related message is visible.
strengths: Matches the familiar email mental model
Makes the required mobile tabs and desktop three panes straightforward
risks: Activity may be under-discovered without an unread badge

bets.name: Activity-led operations center
bets.structure: Activity is the default home and the inbox is a filtered feed; agent work is promoted into a persistent top queue.
risks: Changes the expected email starting point
Competes with message scanning and adds cognitive overhead for a single user

recommendation.label: approved for implementation
recommendation.rationale: A private single-user email tool should make ordinary mail scanning feel familiar and quiet. Activity remains a deliberate, filterable surface for exceptions and agent work instead of turning every inbox visit into an operations dashboard.
